note: Mechanical interface of the custom boards (build/15: three boards + the encoder daughterboard that STACK 5.8 requires to be replaceable). Board coordinates: origin at the lower-left corner of the board outline as seen from the component side; mm. place.origin = enclosure coordinates of that corner; place.z_bottom = z of the board face opposite the components; place.facing = direction the component side faces (+z towards the front face, -z towards the rear wall). Only the mechanical interface is defined here; routing, footprints and Gerbers belong to the PCB work (pcb/).

stackup.components: top side only (build/15), with two exceptions: PWR-A is two-sided (SHRINK-2, W2 MECH-7: chip R/C on the bottom over the plate pockets, boards PWR bottom_side) and the B2B half J209 sits on the PWR-B bottom (boards PWR_B b2b.bottom_side)

PWR.name: power board PWR-A, plate-bonded (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)

place.mount: plate front face; Gelid 0.5 mm pads under the thermal_bond zones, gap 0.4 mm set by shim washers (mechanical.json pwr_bond)

PWR.screw: the M3 male stud of the PWR-A/PWR-B standoff (F45, M3 male-female, body 5.0 = the B2B stack) from the component side (board 1.6 + shim 0.4 + plate 2.0: the stud is 3.53-4.0 long, so it fills the 1.53 thread of the PEM nut flush with the plate front face and its tip ends at most flush with the plate rear face, as the earlier M3 x 4 did; generated/fastener-stacks.json PWR_A-PLATE)
PWR._max_height_note: W2 MECH-3: hA 4.5 of pcb/partition-spec.json parameters (B2B mated stack 5.00 minus 0.5 clearance), the height under the PWR-B mezzanine; PWR-A parts taller than hA stand in PWR-B windows (window ceiling 12.1 = stack 5.0 + board 1.6 + hB 5.5) or in uncovered edge strips (headers). W2 MECH-7 (SHRINK-2): no module stands on PWR-A any more (the Pololu U107/U108 and their two 12.1 mm height zones are gone; the LM61460AANRJRR and TPSM63606RDLR converters are ordinary top-side parts, blocks of 3.2 and 4.1 mm in pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.planned.blocks, both <= hA); the windows over the 15 taller PWR-A refs (pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.window_refs) are a placement rule that PCB-PWRB-2 cuts at the PCB-PWRA-3 placement, not contract cut-outs
PWR._thermal_bond_note: placement contract for the PCB work: TPS7A4701 x2 and LT3045 x2 inside the two lower zones (their exposed pads stitched to bottom copper); W2 MECH-7 (SHRINK-2): zone 3 [7, 39, 17, 24] carries the SYS12 converter block (LM61460AANRJRR with its SRP7030-2R2M inductor and power passives) and zone 4 [7, 73, 14, 14] the LAB5 converter block (TPSM63606RDLR with its power passives) (converter_zones; the zone rectangles are candidates.shrink2.pwr_a_bottom.thermal_bond_planned of pcb/partition-spec.json, W2 AREA-2, and they hold the SHRINK-2 study blocks CONV_SYS12 [8, 40]-[23, 54.3] and CONV_LAB5 [8, 74]-[20, 85.6], MODEL); the exposed pads and the GND/VIN/VOUT copper of each converter are stitched to bottom copper over its zone; zones 1-2 are unchanged; each zone gets one Gelid pad of the same size; rules R-PWR-PADS, R-UFS-REG and R-PWR-ZONES
PWR._converter_zones_note: W2 MECH-7: thermal_bond zone number (1-based) -> reserved block id of pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.planned.blocks that must fit inside it (R-PWR-ZONES, block w x d in either orientation); after GR-5A the real converter footprints replace the blocks and the check moves to them (MECH-7 part 2)

bottom_side.rule: two-sided PWR-A (SHRINK-2 decision (6), W2 AREA-2 / MECH-7): the chip R/C listed in pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.pwr_a_bottom go on the bottom side; every bottom courtyard lies inside one plate pocket PB* (mechanical.json plate.pwr_bottom_pockets, computed by srrx_mech.rules.pwr_bottom_regions; board-coordinate list in mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR bottom_side.keep_in_mm), so it is outside every thermal_bond zone and its land, outside the converter heat corridors and outside the plate-hole lands; it also stays outside every top THT pin field + 1.0 mm (pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.pwr_a_bottom_parts); its height is at most the room h_max = shim gap + pocket depth - polyimide film - clearance (R-PWR-BOTTOM)
bottom_side._clearance_note: design value of this package: shim gap tolerance 0.05 (mechanical.json pwr_bond gap_tol) + pocket depth tolerance 0.05 + 0.2 for board bow between the F45 studs
bottom_side.heights: TBD per MPN: the heights of the bottom chip refs are not read (pcb/partition-spec.json candidates.shrink2.pwr_a_bottom.h_room_formula); PCB-PWRA-3 checks each against h_max

h_trim.rule: rule H-TRIM (pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.h_trim, W2 AREA-2): the THT pins of every PWR-B header and THT part are trimmed flush after soldering, protrusion_max below the PWR-B bottom face; PWR-A may then place parts up to zone_h_max under those pin fields (pin field + window_margin 0.5 each side), so the field costs no PWR-A area
h_trim.zones: under the PWR-B THT pin fields of pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.pwr_a_keepout_items at the PCB-PWRB-2 placement (positions TBD); the new PWR-B spans (boards PWR_B edge_zones 2 and 3: PHD 2x10 on the top span x 84-107, PH 9-pin on the bottom span) put two of them along those edges
h_trim.gate: OPEN: the trimmed protrusion and the 1.3 mm clearance (stack 5.0 - protrusion 1.0 - zone part 2.7) are measured at proof-fit; PCB-PWRB-2 marks every PWR-B THT pin field for flush trim in its fab and assembly notes; if H-TRIM fails, F2-C fires (rule R-H-TRIM)

edge_zones.use: battery circuit (Mini-Fit Jr., 18 AWG), BMS and IP2368 leads
blower, BMS, CTRL harness S02 (JST PH, Micro-Fit); bottom-row ports and GX16 through plate slot SL3

rear-layer harness through plate slot SL2: J206 SL2-PWR-MF (S13, S14, S17, S18; Micro-Fit) and the battery-path S06/S07 leads to the rear-wall INA228 / #2813 (W2 MECH-3 routes); S04, S20-S22 and S35 leave from PWR-B J204/J207 (build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv, W2 GR-3)

PWR._edge_headers_note: W2 MECH-7: exit edge of every PWR-A header of build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv (board PWR_A), from the PCB-PWRA placement study (build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/placement-study.json anchors at wip/w2-pwra1 80d92c28, MODEL): J113, J114, J115 and J507 sit inboard in the bottom-right corner and leave by the right edge; the SHRINK-2 decided set (scratch study of 2026-11-11) moves them to the bottom edge, turned by 90 deg, only if GR-5B adopts the S02 FFC (that move and its edge zones are MECH-7 part 2); rule R-HDR-MATED judges each header on its edge

tht_pockets.rule: every PWR-A THT pad group gets a relief pocket in the plate front face (M-07): pin field + margin on each side, depth >= depth_min, with a polyimide insulator over the pocket and the 0.4 mm shim gap (trimmed THT joints with a bottom fillet stand 0.3-1 mm proud and would pierce the 0.5 mm Gelid pad: pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.pwr_a_tht_pockets); W2 MECH-7: a pin field that lies inside a bottom-part pocket PB* (mechanical.json plate.pwr_bottom_pockets, same depth) needs no pocket of its own
tht_pockets.from_placement: the PWR-A THT groups (radials, the Keystone 3568 holder of F102, the PWR-A harness headers: pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen> pwr_a_tht_pocket_items; W2 MECH-7: no Pololu rows any more, PK1/PK2 are deleted) whose pin fields lie outside the PB pockets, in a thermal_bond zone (the Gelid pad is cut there too), a land or a heat corridor get their own pocket at the PCB-PWRA-3 placement: OPEN until it exists (rule R-PWR-POCKETS prints the current count)
tht_pockets.insulator: polyimide film into each pocket and across the shim gap: AI-POLYIMIDE-TAPE 3M 5413 (W2 MECH-7, mechanical.json plate.pwr_bottom_pockets film)

PWR.notes: Fastening (W2 MECH-3): the M3 male studs of the seven PWR-A/PWR-B standoffs F45 into PEM F-M3-1 self-clinching flush nuts in the plate (pressed flush with the plate front face, M-07; the 1.53 shank stops 0.47 short of the rear face and the stud tip at most flush with it, so nothing reaches the RF side; no cut thread in the plate, STACK 5.8); PWR-B sits on the standoffs (boards.json PWR_B, F46). W2 MECH-7 (SHRINK-2): no module on the board (the Pololu U107/U108 are replaced by the LM61460AANRJRR SYS12 converter in zone 3 and the TPSM63606RDLR LAB5 converter in zone 4; graph refs by GR-5A); the board is two-sided (bottom_side) over the plate pockets PB*. The IP2368 retail board sits on the plate in the HMI column (layout item ip2368). Area check with and without the build/16 harness headers: fit-report 'board_area'.

PWR_B._outline_note: W2 MECH-7 (SHRINK-2): the full PWR-A L (same origin, coaxial holes); the two Pololu windows are deleted with the modules. The windows over the PWR-A parts taller than hA (pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.window_refs: C107, C113, C206, C207, C210, C222, C254, C262, C265, C273, C511, C512, F102, L101, L501; courtyard + window_margin 0.5), the edge strips of the PWR-A harness headers and the probe windows stay a placement rule for PCB-PWRB-2 at the PCB-PWRA-3 placement (windows_mm2, edge_strips_mm2, tp_probe_windows_mm2 and boards.PWR_B.usable_mm2 of the budget), not contract cut-outs; the fit-report board_area row of PWR_B judges the need against that usable area, this outline is only an upper bound
